description: For every theory \(T\) and sentences \(A,B\), \(T\vdash A\to B\) if and only if \(T\cup\{A\}\vdash B\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.derives_imp_iff.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  {T : Set (L.Formula α)} {A B : L.Formula α} :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives T (A.imp B) ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives (insert A T) B
